summary: Verified Xaluca brand overlays (logo + X monogram + appointment bubble) and HeroMonogram on the requested pages. 6/6 card sections (aventura experiences, viajesamedida bespoke types, quehacemos pillars, qvm destination cards, incentivos verticals + cases, cuando-viajar seasons) all expose the correct data-testids and interactive bubble->CTA->/citaprevia flows with NO nested-anchor navigation. 9/10 hero pages render [data-testid=hero-monogram] correctly on desktop and are hidden on mobile (verified hidden md:block). 1 page is missing hero-monogram: /marruecos.

ui_bugs.issue: hero-monogram is MISSING. The /marruecos route resolves to MoroccoLandingPage.jsx (custom Hero with data-testid="mar-hero"), NOT MarruecosPage.jsx (JourneyHero). The custom Hero does not render <HeroMonogram />. Task assumption 'MarruecosPage usa JourneyHero que YA incluye HeroMonogram' is incorrect for this route.

/viajes/aventura.cards: 8/8 aventura-exp-* cards have logo+monogram+bubble; toggle works; CTA -> /citaprevia; no nav on bubble click; 0 console errors

/viajesamedida.cards: 6/6 bespoke-type-* (aventura,pareja,grupo,amigos,familia,deportivo) have logo+monogram+bubble; CTA -> /citaprevia; 0 console errors

/que-ver-en-Marruecos.cards: 17/17 qvm-card-* with logo+monogram+bubble; toggle CTA -> /citaprevia; 0 console errors

/incentivos.cards: 4/4 inc-vertical-* + 3/3 inc-case-* fully branded; CTA -> /citaprevia; 0 console errors

/cuando-viajar.cards: 4/4 when-season-* (spring/summer/autumn/winter) fully branded; CTA -> /citaprevia; 0 console errors

/marruecos.hero_monogram: MISSING — route renders MoroccoLandingPage.jsx Hero (data-testid=mar-hero) which does NOT include <HeroMonogram />

action_items: Add <HeroMonogram /> inside the Hero section of /app/frontend/src/pages/MoroccoLandingPage.jsx (line ~289, section data-testid="mar-hero"), placed after the gradient/film-grain layers and before the foreground content (same pattern as JourneyPageSections.jsx line 74). The section already is position:relative + overflow-hidden, so no further changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: CardBrandOverlay is correctly reused across all 6 card surfaces and renders unconditionally (no provider needed). Good DRY pattern.
Toggle button on ImageContactBubble does not navigate — confirmed bubble click keeps URL on the same page; only image-contact-cta-<slug> anchor navigates to /citaprevia.
HeroMonogram correctly uses 'hidden md:block' so it is desktop-only as specified — verified at viewport 390x844 it is not visible.

Routing inconsistency: /marruecos serves MoroccoLandingPage.jsx but the repo also contains MarruecosPage.jsx which is apparently unused by that route — main agent should confirm whether MarruecosPage.jsx is dead code or should be wired into the router.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (16/17 verified items pass; 1 missing hero-monogram on /marruecos)
